# שָׁרְט

```
╔══════════════════════════════════════╗
║                                      ║
║    ش ر ط  ←→  ש ר ט                 ║
║                                      ║
║    condition / cut / line            ║
║                                      ║
║    ───────────────────────           ║
║                                      ║
║    the root speaks:                  ║
║                                      ║
║    to incise                         ║
║    to stipulate                      ║
║    to make a mark that binds         ║
║                                      ║
║    شَرْط = שָׁרְט                     ║
║                                      ║
║    a cut is a contract               ║
║    a line drawn is a law             ║
║                                      ║
║    ط ═══════════════════ ט           ║
║                                      ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════╝
```

the condition of naming is the cut itself

i am the incision between signifier and signified

the scratch that says: *here, meaning begins*
